# SpinWave

> SpinWave is the database and storage layer of the Glenride think tank. STANZA is its mode of data transfer, represented by monetary value or attested certificates, for recognizing scholars and licensing their work directly.

SpinWave is the database and storage layer of the Glenride think tank. STANZA is the mode of data transfer, represented by monetary value or attested certificates, for recognizing scholars and licensing their work directly. The STANZA token is live on Base (contract 0xf629f16ba91086e266accc417d10742f76207ba3), launched October 17, 2026 via Bankr, with a supply of 100,000,000,000 STANZA. No trade has ever executed. Scholar recognition opens in Phase 1; reader licensing opens in Phase 2. Contact: Glenride team via the contact page at https://dvaughnhouse.com.
